body.name: Ordinary \(Q[S]\) query subclass \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}=\{\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}=(G,S_0,x_0,(\kappa_v)_{v\in V}):G\text{ is a finite semi-Markovian ADMG},\ \varnothing\ne S_0\subseteq V,\ x_0\in\mathfrak X_{V\setminus S_0},\ \kappa_v\in\mathbb Q_{\ge0},\text{ and the target is }Q[S_0](s_0;x_0)=P_{\operatorname{do}(V\setminus S_0=x_0)}(S_0=s_0)\}\).
